subject.title: fix(auto-reply): preserve Unicode in context treemap label truncation

question: Should context-treemap labels remain an ASCII-only sanitized presentation surface, or should the renderer formally accept and preserve Unicode labels?
rationale: The patch is technically valid for Unicode strings, but current described production behavior sanitizes those strings before the helper, so only maintainers can choose whether changing that latent contract is worthwhile.

options.title: Keep the ASCII-only contract
options.body: Close the PR as unnecessary defensive churn because Unicode cannot reach this helper through the intended renderer path.

options.title: Adopt Unicode label support
options.body: Define Unicode labels as supported renderer input, then request a focused test and runtime proof that exercises sanitization and truncation together.

recommendation.title: Keep the ASCII-only contract
recommendation.body: Close the PR as unnecessary defensive churn because Unicode cannot reach this helper through the intended renderer path.
